scope: One task-level independent SPEC review, followed only by targeted remediation review
reviewer: Independent wp01_wave7_spec agent; read-only review of actual code, design data and source clauses

findings.finding: Generic FK/index templates do not identify actual declared columns, referenced entities or uniqueness scopes. Known ProjectNo, IterationNo, RoundNo and Evaluation/ActiveSelection rules must be represented concretely without inventing narrower domains.
findings.required_fix: Define per-entity physical columns and PK/UQ/FK targets/scopes; preserve original identity domains and exact Evaluation meaning. No DDL/runtime adoption requested.
findings.resolution: 31 entities now define physical columns and PK/UQ/FK/index/check/CAS. Original ITER clauses establish one current Evaluation/ActiveSelection per Iteration with immutable successor history; ReviewRoundId may be null. The candidate does not impose an invalid UNIQUE ReviewRoundId restriction.

findings.finding: Obligation evidence can name any top-level source hash, including an unrelated valid source, rather than the specific matrix source_refs and owner_authority. The actual original obligation source is not read/bound.
findings.required_fix: Read and validate the exact per-obligation source files/hash/locations; merge source unions across repeated navigation rows; bind evidence to that obligation. Add unrelated-source substitution and original-source drift negatives.
findings.resolution: The gate reads exact per-obligation source_refs and owner_authority, merges repeated-row sources and binds evidence to the complete source set. Unrelated-source substitution and original-file drift negatives pass after a recorded red run with source snapshots.

other_scope: No additional required findings in eight decision dispositions, historical gaps, required DAG chains, three completion predicates or disabled production boundary.
test_policy: Initial successful 45-test result reused for review. Changed gate behavior requires targeted local regression; unchanged manager result reused. No Actions, database or production execution.
targeted_review_scope: Original two findings and direct impact only; no additional required findings. Reviewed actual original ITER clauses and test source hash consistency.
